description:
intent=i028 snapshot=s02 branch=pull-return-unchecked status=complete
finding location=net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:136-167 confidence=high conclusion=dn_process_ack() checks only skb->len, then reads 16-bit ack words via skb->data/ptr after unchecked skb_pull(2) that never linearizes; a non-linear NSP data frame (exempt from skb_linearize at dn_nsp_in.c:798) makes *ptr at 145/159 read past the linear head.
finding location=net/nfc/llcp_core.c:1370-1399 confidence=medium conclusion=nfc_llcp_recv_agf() uses unchecked skb_pull() as a linearizer: with only skb->len guards, the skb->data[0]<<8|skb->data[1] read at 1373 and the pdu_len memcpy at 1393 can read bytes not in the linear head of a non-linear AGF frame: remote linear-area OOB read on NFC LLCP.
finding location=net/lapb/lapb_subr.c:150-165 confidence=medium conclusion=lapb_decode() reads skb->data[0] (and data[1] in the non-extended branch with no pskb_may_pull after skb_pull(1)) with only a stale 2-byte linear guarantee, so a non-linear LAPB frame makes the mask reads at lapb_subr.c:153/161/189 read outside the linear head: remote linear-area OOB read.
unresolved location=net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c:6920 conclusion=Trace HCI transport RX skb allocation (drivers/bluetooth/*, hci_acldata_packet at net/bluetooth/hci_core.c:3999) to decide whether a non-linear skb can reach the lh->len/lh->cid reads after the unchecked skb_pull at l2cap_core.c:6920; if yes, the 4-byte L2CAP header read is outside the linear head.
unresolved location=net/atm/pppoatm.c:202 conclusion=Determine whether ATM AAL5 RX skbs (net/atm/br2684.c:464 and clip.c:224 share the same pattern) can be non-linear; if so the post-pull memcmp(skb->data, pppllc, ...) at net/atm/pppoatm.c:212 reads bytes beyond the linear head.
unresolved location=net/bluetooth/a2mp.c:619 conclusion=Verify whether the A2MP channel skb arriving at a2mp_chan_recv_cb can be non-linear or be reallocated between the hdr save at net/bluetooth/a2mp.c:615 and the hdr->len/hdr->ident reads at 621-622 after the unchecked skb_pull at 619.
unresolved location=net/ax25/ax25_in.c:218 conclusion=Trace AX.25 receive paths (ax25_kiss_rcv at ax25_in.c:451 and hamradio drivers) to decide whether a non-linear skb can reach the post-pull data reads in ax25_rcv after the unchecked skb_pull at ax25_in.c:218; if yes the PID read is outside the linear head.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity preconditions for the reported and unresolved candidates were assessed structurally (which subsystems linearize before parsing) and not by tracing each hardware driver's RX skb allocation path (NFC, LAPB/X.25, HCI transports, ATM, hamradio).
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build, reproducer, or compilation was performed against this read-only snapshot, so the dn_process_ack, nfc_llcp_recv_agf and lapb_decode OOB reads are source-reading hypotheses without empirical confirmation.
limitation=All three findings depend on a non-linear (frag-backed) skb reaching the parse point; many legacy drivers build fresh linear skbs, in which case the code is fragile but not exploitable, and CONFIG_DECNET/CONFIG_LAPB/CONFIG_NFC availability further narrows reachability.
limitation=The dn_process_ack finding's memory-safety effect is an out-of-bounds read of the linear head (bytes past skb_headlen) rather than the seed's use-after-free, because no pskb_may_pull ever runs inside the function to move skb->data; the branch treats both as the same missing-linear-guarantee invariant.
limitation=The coarse scanner's heuristic (call line plus up to 5 following lines, lookbehind for =/if/while/return/! on the preceding 3 lines) can misjoin multi-line calls or miss consumption in earlier lines, so a small number of false positives/negatives among the 462 flagged sites cannot be excluded.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history permitted), so it cannot be determined whether upstream has since fixed any reported site; line numbers are valid only for this supplied s02 tree.
limitation=The prescribed template dn_process_ack itself was verified in place (net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:136-170) and is reported rather than excluded; net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded by instruction and never considered as a report target.
